title: rosa × falcata var. intricata
intro: Rosa × falcata var. intricata, commonly known as intricata rose or intricata hybrid rose, is a specific variety of the Rosa × falcata species, a hybrid rose. It is known for its unique and intricate flower patterns, making it a popular choice among rose enthusiasts. Rosa × falcata var. intricata has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
